variants.failure: The handoff says credit issued, but only a proposal exists. Correct status and include the operation ledger before transferring.
variants.nearest_alternative: A transcript dump does not ensure an actionable handoff; a vague complaint is not identical to an explicit human request.
variants.conditional_cue: Hear the trigger; hand over facts, status and next action.

variants.title: Propagate partial success without hiding failure
variants.base_case: Specialists return findings and structured failures to the coordinator. Preserve successful evidence and decide which missing dimensions block the final claim.
variants.changed_constraint: The unavailable source is explicitly optional. Publish a bounded partial answer with the omission and limitations visible.
variants.failure: A mandatory permissions source fails. Target that recovery or stop the affected conclusion; do not replace its facts with another specialist’s guess.
variants.nearest_alternative: Discarding all successes wastes evidence; silently dropping a failed mandatory dimension fabricates completeness.
variants.conditional_cue: Keep the successes; name the gap; block dependent claims.

variants.title: Build a minimal code evidence ledger
variants.base_case: A large codebase bug starts with targeted symbol search, relevant caller reads and a file/dependency ledger. Expand only the evidence path needed for the defect.
variants.changed_constraint: The failure crosses the API boundary. Add the adjacent client/server dependencies and contract tests rather than preserving an artificially narrow scope.
variants.failure: Compaction loses a function’s exception condition. Re-read the actual file at the current commit before editing.
variants.nearest_alternative: A guessed summary cannot replace current code evidence. Reading the whole repository also makes the decisive detail harder to retain.
variants.conditional_cue: Map the path; read the dependency; refresh before edit.

variants.title: Test risk slices and review capacity
variants.base_case: A finance extractor has high overall accuracy but weaker rare-currency performance. Evaluate severity-weighted slices on independent holdout and calibrate review thresholds with actual human capacity.
variants.changed_constraint: A review queue exceeds available capacity. Apply a declared overflow policy or reduce scope; do not silently accept low-confidence items.
variants.failure: Distribution drift breaks calibration. Recalibrate on suitable data and evaluate on a separate holdout; do not tune against the final test set.
variants.nearest_alternative: The average can hide dangerous categories; confidence scores alone are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
variants.conditional_cue: Average, slice, severity, capacity: check all four.

variants.title: Keep sources through a join
variants.base_case: Separate finance and CRM interfaces return revenue and customer records with timestamps and field-level provenance. Join only under a declared identifier rule.
variants.changed_constraint: The host offers supported federation. It may simplify retrieval, but still retain origin, time and conflict checks.
variants.failure: CRM says customer active while finance reports suspended at a different date. Preserve both assertions and their scope; ask for policy or current authoritative evidence.
variants.nearest_alternative: A joined table can erase provenance and make mismatched-age sources look consistent. Federation does not establish truth by itself.
variants.conditional_cue: Join identifiers; retain origins; expose disagreement.
